caption: Phytoplasma disease symptoms in weed species at IARI, New Delhi; panels (a) and (b) compare healthy and phytoplasma-infected Cannabis sativa (Figure 4).
creator: Aido Taloh, D. V. S. Raju, Namita Banyal, Gunjeet Kumar, Priyam Panda, R. Manimekalai, Carmine Marcone, G. P. Rao, and coauthors
confirmation: Peer-reviewed open-access study used nested PCR, sequencing, BLAST/phylogenetic analysis and in-silico RFLP. The Cannabis sativa phytoplasma strain MF509775 grouped with 16SrVI and was assigned to subgroup 16SrVI-D; Figure 4 includes healthy and infected Cannabis panels.
limitations: Multi-species composite; only panels (a) and (b) depict Cannabis sativa. Use as a molecularly anchored phytoplasma reference, not a visual confirmation tool. Witches' broom, chlorosis and stunting overlap other disorders. Keep the full figure training-ineligible until Cannabis panels are independently cropped, hashed and reviewed.
